requirements.quote: Add packages/ui/src/patterns/citation-status.tsx (verified, not found, unknown: glyph plus text label, Provenance Chip conventions, story and test), export it from patterns/index.ts.
Add packages/i18n/src/messages/{en,ta,kn}/drafting.json with every key the studio needs (list, states, panels, dialogs, shortcuts, findings, offline, AI-drafted, export, acknowledgement statement)
register the namespace in packages/i18n/src/catalog.ts and __tests__/catalog.test.ts.

deliverables.change: New CitationStatus component: status 'verified'|'not_found'|'unknown' (local union, no core import); lucide glyph aria-hidden + visible text label (optional `label` prop for translations, English defaults); capsule classes like stage-badge/provenance chip (min-h, rounded-full, text-xs, forced-colors:border-current, wrapping label); data-slot and data-status attrs; status never conveyed by colour alone.
Story showing all three statuses and a long-label case.
Test each status renders its text label, glyph is aria-hidden, label override and data-status; model on stage-badge.test.tsx.
Export CitationStatus, props type and status type/meta.

Single top-level key `drafting` (NOT top-level offline/shortcuts, which exist) with nested list, states, panels, dialogs, shortcuts, findings, offline, aiDrafted, export, acknowledgement statement, citation status labels. ICU strings.
Same key set as en, real Tamil text (must differ from en; same ICU args).
Same key set as en, real Kannada text.
Add 'drafting' to the top-level key list; add a small test that drafting exists in every locale with citation status labels and the acknowledgement statement.
Add every drafting.* leaf as "draft" under ta and kn.

preserve.what: Existing top-level catalog keys (offline, shortcuts, draftingTemplates etc.) and the drafting-templates namespace files in packages/i18n/src/messages/*/drafting-templates.json
UI import allow-list in packages/ui/src/patterns/boundaries.test.ts: no new dependencies, no @causedeck/core import in packages/ui

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/ui exec vitest run src/patterns/citation-status src/patterns/boundaries.test.ts src/patterns/provenance-chip
pnpm --filter @causedeck/i18n exec vitest run src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts src/__tests__/check-catalogs.test.ts

decisions.choice: Use a single top-level key `drafting` in drafting.json
decisions.justification: offline and shortcuts are already top-level keys in other files; mergeNamespaces throws on duplicates (packages/i18n/src/catalog.ts:55-70)

decisions.choice: Define the citation status union locally in packages/ui
decisions.justification: UI package must not depend on core; allowed imports listed in packages/ui/src/patterns/boundaries.test.ts:5-13
